content:
**Fox Jerky** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Fox Meat that has been cooked with wood to make jerky. Consuming it will give a moderate boost to Agility, satisfy a moderate amount of hunger, and restore a large amount of HP at the cost of moderate rads. Cooking this dish is a required task to earn the archaeologist Possum Badge and complete the associated world challenge.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Fox Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Fox Meat | | Fox Jerky (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up Fox Meat for the first time.
